shortDescription: Manages network offerings on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: availability
options.description: The availability of network offering. Default value is Optional

options.name: conserve_mode
options.description: Whether the network offering has IP conserve mode enabled.

options.name: details
options.description: Network offering details in key/value pairs. with service provider as a value

options.name: display_text
options.description: Display text of the network offerings.

options.name: domains
options.description: List of domains the network offering is related to. Use C(public) for public offerings.

options.name: egress_default_policy
options.description: Whether the default egress policy is allow or to deny.

options.name: for_vpc
options.description: Whether the offering is meant to be used for VPC or not.

options.name: guest_ip_type
options.description: Guest type of the network offering.

options.name: keepalive_enabled
options.description: If true keepalive will be turned on in the loadbalancer. At the time of writing this has only an effect on haproxy. the mode http and httpclose options are unset in the haproxy conf file.

options.name: max_connections
options.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections supported by the network offering.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the network offering.

options.name: network_rate
options.description: Data transfer rate in megabits per second allowed.

options.name: persistent
options.description: True if network offering supports persistent networks defaulted to false if not specified

options.name: service_capabilities
options.description: Desired service capabilities as part of network offering.

options.name: service_offering
options.description: The service offering name or ID used by virtual router provider.

options.name: service_providers
options.description: Provider to service mapping. If not specified, the provider for the service will be mapped to the default provider on the physical network.

options.name: specify_ip_ranges
options.description: Whether the network offering supports specifying IP ranges. Defaulted to C(false) by the API if not specified.

options.name: specify_vlan
options.description: Whether the network offering supports vlans or not.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the network offering.

options.name: supported_services
options.description: Services supported by the network offering. A list of one or more items from the choice list.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of strings. To delete all tags, set an empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: traffic_type
options.description: The traffic type for the network offering.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: zones
options.description: List of zones the network offering is related to. Use C(all) for all zones offering.
